visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit kitchen. A woman wearing a white shirt and a pink apron is washing a head of cauliflower in a stainless steel bowl filled with water under a faucet. (2) The scene cuts to a wooden cutting board where the woman uses a chef's knife to divide the cauliflower into small florets. (3) A close-up shows her holding a floret, inspecting it closely near a window. (4) Frozen shrimp are placed in a metal bowl and rinsed with running water. (5) Long strands of green kelp are bundled together and sliced into uniform segments on the cutting board. (6) Red chili peppers are sliced diagonally, and garlic cloves are minced into fine pieces. (7) A red pot of water is brought to a boil on a stove; the woman adds salt, ginger slices, and the kelp to blanch. (8) Mushrooms are prepared and sautéed in a pot until slightly browned, then hot water and soup base packets are added. (9) Cauliflower and shrimp are arranged on a steaming tray and placed into a modern black steam oven. (10) Two pieces of salmon are seasoned with salt and pepper, coated with flour, and seared in a frying pan until golden. (11) The kelp is stir-fried with the minced garlic and chili in the same pan. (12) The final meal, consisting of four dishes and one soup, is arranged on a wooden tray. The woman sits down and enjoys the meal, expressing satisfaction through smiles and nodding.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 先將花椰菜整朵清洗兩遍 浸泡幾分鐘. (2) [Subtitle]: 將花椰菜分成小朵. (3) [Subtitle]: 仔細檢查有沒有菜蟲.. (4) [Subtitle]: 10隻冷凍蝦沖水一下 解凍.... (5) [Subtitle]: 海帶絲整理成一束 切成等長... (6) [Subtitle]: 辣椒斜切成片 蒜頭剁成蒜末... (7) [Subtitle]: 飲水機取用熱水 加入適量鹽... (用熱水煮比較快!) (8) [Subtitle]: 加入四片薑片... (9) [Subtitle]: 水滾後放入海帶絲 汆燙3分鐘... (10) [Subtitle]: 取出瀝乾... (11) [Subtitle]: 準備一些菇 分成小朵狀... (12) [Subtitle]: 菇放入鍋裡、開中小火加熱 壓一下，煎出焦香. (13) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下. (14) [Subtitle]: 等到菇表面煎出焦香 倒入熱水1100ml. (15) [Subtitle]: 放入兩包昆布柴魚高湯包. (16) [Subtitle]: 一小撮鹽、醬油、味醂、清酒調味. (17) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後轉小火 蓋上鍋蓋 煮12分鐘. (18) [Subtitle]: 空檔的時候 幫花椰菜調味一下. (19) [Subtitle]: 放上蒸盤. (20) [Subtitle]: 蝦不用調味 放在盤子上. (21) [Subtitle]: 裝兩碗糙米飯. (22) [Subtitle]: 將花椰菜、蝦糙米飯 一起放入蒸烤爐100度加熱. (23) [Subtitle]: 設定16分鐘... (24) [Subtitle]: 蝦蒸10分鐘就可以取出了！ (25) [Subtitle]: 花椰菜放回去 跟糙米飯繼續再蒸6分鐘. (26) [Subtitle]: 鮭魚表面灑上鹽跟胡椒. (27) [Subtitle]: 翻面再灑上鹽跟胡椒. (28) [Subtitle]: 表面撒上一點麵粉 可以鎖住鮭魚的水分. (29) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡加入適量的油. (30) [Subtitle]: 等油熱之後放入鮭魚進來 煎出表面焦香. (31) [Subtitle]: 兩面煎出焦香後，立起來 煎魚皮那一側. (32) [Subtitle]: 另外一邊也煎一下. (33) [Subtitle]: 好囉，可以起鍋了. (34) [Subtitle]: 酥酥香香的 鮭魚排就煎好了！ (35) [Subtitle]: 取出多餘的油 鍋裡放入蒜末、辣椒... (36) [Subtitle]: 煸出蒜香. (37) [Subtitle]: 放入海帶絲 拌炒均勻. (38) [Subtitle]: 鍋底放入醬汁 嗆出醬香. (39) [Subtitle]: 快速的拌炒均勻 讓海帶吸收醬汁... (40) [Subtitle]: 起鍋前，撒上胡椒調味. (41) [Subtitle]: 上桌前 淋上一點芝麻油 會很香喔！ (42) [Subtitle]: 像這樣～四菜一湯 就做好啦～ ❤️. (43) [Subtitle]: 碗裡放入一點九層塔 淋上熱熱的湯... (44) [Subtitle]: 湯的香氣會很棒 ❤️. (45) [Subtitle]: 看起來好好吃喔 ❤️. (46) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉～ ❤️. (47) [Subtitle]: 好香的湯～ ❤️. (48) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 Youtube:@RosalinaKitchen. (49) [Subtitle]: 蝦也太好吃了吧～ ❤️
